title: Kongjwi and Patjwi
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.prop:<jar|pail|basketY|basketR|drum|buk|: 소품·연출(쓸기 먼지·물 붓기·독 새기·채우기·참새 쪼기·징검다리 건너기·꽃신 떠내려가기·신기기)

lines.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 고운 콩쥐가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, there lived a kind girl named Kongjwi.
segs: Once upon a time, there lived a kind girl named Kongjwi.

lines.text: 콩쥐는 새엄마, 팥쥐와 함께 살았어요.
lines.en: She lived with her stepmother and Patjwi.
segs: She lived with her stepmother and Patjwi.

lines.text: 팥쥐는 날마다 뒹굴뒹굴 놀고, 떡을 냠냠 먹기만 했지요.
lines.en: Patjwi just lolled about all day, lounging and munching on rice cakes, yum, yum.
segs: Patjwi just lolled about all day, lounging and munching on rice cakes, yum, yum.

lines.text: "콩쥐야, 마당을 쓸어라!" 새엄마가 말했어요.
lines.en: Kongjwi, sweep the yard! said her stepmother.

lines.text: 콩쥐는 빗자루를 들고 싹싹, 마당을 쓸었어요.
lines.en: Kongjwi picked up the broom and swept the yard, swish, swish, swish.
segs: Kongjwi picked up the broom and swept the yard, swish, swish, swish.

lines.text: 마당이 깨끗해졌어요. 콩쥐는 방긋 웃었어요.
lines.en: The yard was clean. Kongjwi smiled.
segs: The yard was clean. Kongjwi smiled.

lines.text: "이 밭을 다 갈아 놓아라!" 새엄마가 말했어요.
lines.en: Plow this whole field! said her stepmother.

lines.text: 밭은 너무 넓어서 콩쥐는 한숨이 나왔어요.
lines.en: The field was so big that Kongjwi sighed.
segs: The field was so big that Kongjwi sighed.

lines.text: 콩쥐는 호미로 땅을 콕콕 파기 시작했어요. 땀이 뚝뚝 떨어졌지요.
lines.en: Kongjwi began to dig at the earth with her little hoe, poke, poke. Sweat dripped down, drip, drop.
segs: Kongjwi began to dig at the earth with her little hoe, poke, poke. Sweat dripped down, drip, drop.

lines.text: 그때 검은 소가 나타났어요. "음메~ 내가 도와줄게!"
lines.en: Then a black ox appeared. Moo! I will help you!

lines.text: 소가 쑥쑥 밭을 갈아 주었어요. "고마워, 소야!"
lines.en: The ox plowed the field fast. Thank you, ox!
segs: The ox plowed the field fast.

lines.text: "이 독에 물을 가득 채워라!" 새엄마가 말했어요.
lines.en: Fill this big jar with water! said her stepmother.
segs: Fill this big jar with water!

lines.text: 콩쥐는 물동이를 들고 우물을 오르락내리락, 물을 콸콸 부었어요.
lines.en: Kongjwi carried the bucket back and forth to the well and poured the water in, glug, glug, glug.
segs: Kongjwi carried the bucket back and forth to the well and poured the water in, glug, glug, glug.

lines.text: 앗! 독 밑에 구멍이 나서 물이 줄줄 새어 나왔어요.
lines.en: Oh no! There was a hole in the jar, and the water leaked out.
segs: Oh no! There was a hole in the jar, and the water leaked out.

lines.text: 부어도 부어도 독은 텅텅 비었어요. 콩쥐는 울상이 되었지요.
lines.en: No matter how much she poured, the jar stayed empty. Kongjwi was about to cry.
segs: No matter how much she poured, the jar stayed empty. Kongjwi was about to cry.

lines.text: 그때 두꺼비가 폴짝 나타났어요. "내가 구멍을 막아 줄게!"
lines.en: Then a toad hopped over. I will plug the hole!

lines.text: 두꺼비가 구멍에 쏙! 이제 물이 새지 않아요.
lines.en: The toad slipped into the hole! Now the water does not leak.
segs: The toad slipped into the hole! Now the water does not leak.

lines.text: 콩쥐는 다시 물을 콸콸 부었어요. 독이 찰랑찰랑 차올랐지요.
lines.en: Kongjwi poured the water again, glug, glug. The jar filled up, slosh, slosh, to the brim.
segs: Kongjwi poured the water again, glug, glug. The jar filled up, slosh, slosh, to the brim.

lines.text: 독이 물로 가득 찼어요. "고마워, 두꺼비야!"
lines.en: The jar was full of water. Thank you, toad!
segs: The jar was full of water.

lines.text: "겉겨를 벗겨서 쌀을 가져오너라!" 새엄마가 말했어요.
lines.en: Peel the husks and bring me the rice! said her stepmother.
segs: Peel the husks and bring me the rice!

lines.text: 곡식이 너무 많아서 콩쥐는 걱정이 되었어요.
lines.en: There was so much grain that Kongjwi felt worried.
segs: There was so much grain that Kongjwi felt worried.

lines.text: 그때 참새들이 날아왔어요. "짹짹! 우리가 도와줄게!"
lines.en: Then sparrows flew in. Tweet tweet! We will help!

lines.text: 참새들이 콕콕 쪼아서 껍질을 벗겨 주었어요.
lines.from: 참새들이 콕콕 쪼아서 껍질을 벗겨 주었어요. 참새를 하나씩 세어 봐요!
lines.en: The sparrows pecked and peeled the husks.
segs: The sparrows pecked and peeled the husks.

lines.text: 짹짹, 콕콕! 쌀이 금방 하얗게 되었어요.
lines.en: Tweet, tweet, peck, peck! The rice soon turned snowy white.
segs: Tweet, tweet, peck, peck! The rice soon turned snowy white.

lines.text: "고마워, 참새들아!" 콩쥐는 참새들에게 손을 흔들었어요.
lines.en: "Thank you, little sparrows!" Kongjwi waved to the sparrows as they flew away.
segs: Kongjwi waved to the sparrows as they flew away.

lines.text: 이제 콩쥐는 베를 짜야 했어요. 콩쥐는 열심히 베를 짰어요.
lines.en: Now Kongjwi had to weave cloth. She wove very hard.
segs: Now Kongjwi had to weave cloth. She wove very hard.

lines.text: 찰칵찰칵, 베틀 소리가 밤늦도록 이어졌지요.
lines.en: Clack, clack, clack, the loom sang on late into the night.
segs: Clack, clack, clack, the loom sang on late into the night.

lines.text: 그때 하늘에서 선녀가 내려왔어요. "착한 콩쥐야, 선물을 줄게!"
lines.en: Then a fairy came down from the sky. Kind Kongjwi, I have a gift for you!
segs: Then a fairy came down from the sky.
Kind Kongjwi, I have a gift for you!

lines.text: 콩쥐는 곱디고운 옷과 나비 꽃신을 받았어요. "고맙습니다, 선녀님!"
lines.en: Kongjwi got a beautiful dress and butterfly shoes. Thank you, fairy!
segs: Kongjwi got a beautiful dress and butterfly shoes.

lines.text: 꽃신은 반짝반짝, 나비가 팔랑팔랑 날아갈 것만 같았어요.
lines.en: The shoes sparkled and shone, and the butterflies on them looked ready to flutter away.
segs: The shoes sparkled and shone, and the butterflies on them looked ready to flutter away.

lines.text: 콩쥐는 잔치에 가려고 개울을 건너기로 했어요.
lines.from: 콩쥐는 잔치에 가려고 개울을 건너기로 했어요. 징검다리를 톡! 건너 봐요!
lines.en: Kongjwi crossed the stream to go to the feast.
segs: Kongjwi crossed the stream to go to the feast.

lines.text: 징검다리를 폴짝, 폴짝, 폴짝! 개울물은 졸졸 흘렀어요.
lines.en: Hop, hop, hop across the stepping stones! The stream trickled and babbled along.
segs: Hop, hop, hop across the stepping stones! The stream trickled and babbled along.

lines.text: 풍덩! 꽃신 한 짝이 개울에 빠졌어요. 꽃신은 둥둥 떠내려갔어요.
lines.en: Splash! One shoe fell into the stream and floated away.
segs: Splash! One shoe fell into the stream and floated away.

lines.text: 콩쥐는 아쉬웠지만 한 짝만 신고 잔치로 갔어요.
lines.en: Kongjwi felt sad, but she went to the feast with one shoe.
segs: Kongjwi felt sad, but she went to the feast with one shoe.

lines.text: 잔치에서는 북과 장구와 꽹과리 소리가 울렸어요.
lines.from: 잔치에서는 북과 장구와 꽹과리 소리가 울렸어요. 북을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: At the feast, drums and gongs rang out.
segs: At the feast, drums and gongs rang out.

lines.text: 둥둥! 덩덩! 꽹꽹! 어깨가 절로 들썩들썩했지요.
lines.en: Boom, boom! Dung, dung! Clang, clang! Everyone's shoulders bounced along to the beat.
segs: Boom, boom! Dung, dung! Clang, clang! Everyone's shoulders bounced along to the beat.

lines.text: 모두 신나게 춤을 추었어요. 새엄마와 팥쥐도 곱게 차려입고 왔어요.
lines.en: Everyone danced happily. Her stepmother and Patjwi came in fancy clothes too.
segs: Everyone danced happily. Her stepmother and Patjwi came in fancy clothes too.

lines.text: 콩쥐를 본 새엄마와 팥쥐는 부끄러워서 부채로 얼굴을 가렸어요.
lines.en: When they saw Kongjwi, her stepmother and Patjwi felt shy and hid their faces behind fans.
segs: When they saw Kongjwi, her stepmother and Patjwi felt shy and hid their faces behind fans.

lines.text: "어머, 저게 콩쥐라고?" 팥쥐는 부채 뒤에서 눈만 빼꼼 내밀었어요.
lines.en: "What? That is Kongjwi?" Patjwi peeked out from behind her fan with just her eyes.
segs: Patjwi peeked out from behind her fan with just her eyes.

lines.text: 개울에 빠진 꽃신은 원님에게 닿았어요. "이 꽃신의 주인을 찾아요!"
lines.en: The lost shoe reached the magistrate. Let's find who owns this shoe!
segs: The lost shoe reached the magistrate.
Let's find who owns this shoe!

lines.text: 마을 처녀들이 줄줄이 와서 꽃신을 신어 보았지만, 아무에게도 맞지 않았어요.
lines.en: The village girls lined up one by one to try the shoe, but it fit no one at all.
segs: The village girls lined up one by one to try the shoe, but it fit no one at all.

lines.text: "꼭 맞는 사람이 있을 거요." 원님은 콩쥐에게 꽃신을 내밀었어요.
lines.en: "Someone must fit this shoe." The magistrate held the shoe out to Kongjwi.
segs: The magistrate held the shoe out to Kongjwi.

lines.text: 원님이 콩쥐에게 꽃신을 신겨 주었어요. 꼭 맞았어요!
lines.en: The magistrate put the shoe on Kongjwi. It fit perfectly!
segs: The magistrate put the shoe on Kongjwi. It fit perfectly!

lines.text: 콩쥐와 원님은 혼례를 올렸어요. 콩쥐는 곱게 차린 신부가 되었어요.
lines.en: Kongjwi and the magistrate got married. Kongjwi became a lovely bride.
segs: Kongjwi and the magistrate got married. Kongjwi became a lovely bride.

lines.text: "콩쥐야, 그동안 미안했어." 새엄마와 팥쥐가 고개를 숙였어요.
lines.en: Kongjwi, I am sorry for everything. Her stepmother and Patjwi bowed their heads.
segs: Kongjwi, I am sorry for everything.
Her stepmother and Patjwi bowed their heads.

lines.text: 콩쥐는 웃으며 말했어요. "괜찮아요. 우리 같이 지내요."
lines.en: Kongjwi smiled and said, It's okay. Let's live together.

lines.text: 모두 함께 떡을 나눠 먹어요.
lines.en: Everyone shares rice cakes.

lines.text: 쫀득쫀득 떡을 냠냠, 웃음소리가 하하 호호 울려 퍼졌어요.
lines.en: Chewy rice cakes, yum, yum, and laughter rang out, ha ha, ho ho.
segs: Chewy rice cakes, yum, yum, and laughter rang out, ha ha, ho ho.

lines.text: 모두 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.from: 모두 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요. 콩쥐를 톡! 모두 함께 만세!
lines.en: Everyone sat around and ate happily.
segs: Everyone sat around and ate happily.

lines.text: 착한 마음은 도움을 불러와요. 콩쥐팥쥐 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.
lines.en: A kind heart brings help. And that is how the story of Kongjwi and Patjwi ended.
segs: A kind heart brings help. And that is how the story of Kongjwi and Patjwi ended.
